notes: v484 — 📡 The Market Radar has been rebuilt on a proper grid. Every group now starts in the same place, the tiles line up in columns down the whole bar, and the labels share one column instead of six — so it reads as one instrument rather than six loose boxes. Nothing is hidden and nothing is cut off: the long captions that used to be chopped ('REL-STRE…') are whole again. Tiles showing 0 fade back so the numbers that matter stand out, and they still filter when you tap them. It is also slightly shorter than before, on the desktop and on a phone. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5) to update.
